description: This file defines the NotesProvider class, which manages the state of notes in a Flutter application. It handles loading, adding, updating, deleting, and retrieving notes, interacting with a repository for persistence and notifying listeners of state changes.

classes.name: NotesProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier that manages a list of notes, providing methods to initialize, add, update, delete, and retrieve notes while notifying listeners of changes.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Loads notes from the repository if not already initialized.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new note to the list and persists the change.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing note and persists the change.

methods.name: deleteById
methods.description: Removes a note by its ID and updates persistence.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a note by its ID, returns a new note if not found.
